summary.text: Janet Yang Rohr is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 41st District, based in Naperville.

paragraphs.text: According to her Illinois House Democrats biography, she holds a B.A. in English and economics from Northwestern University and an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.
The biography says she is Director of Global Data at Morningstar, served on the Naperville District 203 school board from 2017 to 2021, and is a longtime Naperville resident.
